title: Lew Chudd: tight and mean-spirited
summary: Chudd was tough in sessions and with advances except for Fats Domino, and sent a rude letter complaining about Matassa's $15 hourly rate.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: So, like I say, you'd have to qualify almost everybody. Lou Chud, for instance, in the back of my... I have no proof of this. And if somebody challenged me, I probably... In the back of my mind, he, I think, played with the numbers.

Okay. And he also was tough to do a session with. And he was monstrously tight. Guys who would be hurting and needing an advance, it was tough to get money out of. Except Fats Domino. He, I saw he may have to come up with thousands and thousands of dollars. But he knew what Fats was worth. Sure. And so, I don't think he did it out of the goodness of his heart. But, man, he was tough for guys that, you know... Like I say, you know, I need to pay my rent kind of thing. And in three months, I'm going to get $800 of royalties. I need $300 now. No way. No way.
Mm-hmm. Yeah. You said he... You described Lou as a cynic. Well, how do you... Hmm? You said he was a cynic.
Yeah, I think he didn't always ascribe the best qualities of people he did business with.

You know? He was sometimes downright mean-spirited with people. Even me. I remember once, I sent him a bill. In fact, it was a Fats Domino session. In those days, the early days, I was only charging $15 an hour for the studio. Fifteen? The studio and me, both, okay? Fifteen bucks an hour. And I sent the bill, and he sent me back a letter, without using those words, saying I overcharged him. And he said things like, well, there are studios out here that make yours sound like crap and all that. And I only paid $35 an hour there, so, you know, what do you charge me? And that kind of thing. Really, really, really bad. It was a rotten letter. I should have saved it, you know, to keep my mind focused a little better.
